All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Application
Represents a student's application to a specific internship opportunity.
ApplicationManager
Manages application lifecycle operations between Students and Company Representatives, including applying, rep approval/rejection, and student acceptance/rejection of offers.
ApplicationRepository
In-memory repository for Application entities with query helpers by student/opportunity.
ApplicationStatus
Enum representing the status of an application.
AuthService
Provides authentication (login/logout) and basic role verification for users.
CareerStaff
Represents a career staff member in the internship management portal.
CareerStaffCliMenu
CLI menu for Career Staff users to approve/reject company representatives and internship opportunities, process withdrawal requests, generate reports and configure persistent filters.
CompanyRep
Represents a company representative in the internship management portal.
CompanyRepCliMenu
CLI menu for Company Representative users to create, view, edit, delete and manage internship opportunities as well as review applications.
CSVImporter
Utility class for importing/exporting user-related data from/to CSV files.
DataStore
DataStore handles the serialization and deserialization of users, internship opportunities, and applications to and from files.
FilterSettings
Represents filter settings for querying internship opportunities.
IApplicationRepository
Contract for Application data persistence and retrieval operations.
InternshipLevel
Enum representing the level of an internship opportunity.
InternshipOpportunity
Represents an internship opportunity in the internship management portal.
IOpportunityRepository
Contract for InternshipOpportunity data persistence and retrieval operations.
IUserRepository
Contract for User data persistence and retrieval operations.
LoginUI
LoginUI handles user login and registration interactions via CLI.
MainApp
MainApp is the entry point for the Internship Placement Management System CLI application.
OpportunityManager
Manages lifecycle operations for internship opportunities including draft creation, submission, approval/rejection, visibility toggling and eligibility checks.
OpportunityRepository
In-memory repository for InternshipOpportunity entities with various query helpers.
OpportunityStatus
Enum representing the status of an internship opportunity.
ReportManager
Generates analytical and filtered reports about internship opportunities and related applications.
Student
Represents a student in the internship management portal.
StudentCliMenu
StudentCliMenu provides a command-line interface for student users to interact with the internship placement management system.
User
Represents a user in the internship management portal.
UserManager
Manages user-related operations such as password changes and CompanyRep approval/rejection tracking.
UserRepository
In-memory repository for User entities including tracking of CompanyRep approval/rejection state.
WithdrawalManager
Manages withdrawal requests lifecycle: creation, approval, rejection and side-effects on applications and opportunities.
WithdrawalRequest
Represents a student's request to withdraw an existing application.
